$description: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast pairs checked by the token build, on top of the `contrast` declared on semantic tokens (those are all against surface.solid). Every pair runs in light and dark, and again under each client theme in tokens/themes when that theme changes one of its colours. Text needs 4.5:1 (1.4.3; the app's 12px and 13px labels are never large text); controls, focus rings and graphics need 3:1 (1.4.11). `bg` may be a list. Translucent backgrounds are composited over `over`, by default surface.solid. Gradients are checked at every stop.

pairs.why: Body text on every surface, selected rows and status chips
Accent text: eyebrows, Add a reason, Hide, See why, award count, Changed
Ghost buttons, including Continue on the prerequisite nudge
12px attention text: Bottleneck this week, urgent inbox label
Text on accent fills, such as the selected style letter
Primary button label, at every stop of the brand gradient
Toast text on its inverted fill
Style tooltip text on its inverted fill
Off switch track against its surface. In dark the light thumb carries the boundary (next pair)
Off switch thumb against its track
On switch thumb against the brand gradient
